messages:
maya: Quick question — one of my reports is relocating from EU -> US the same month we want to promo them. Manager asked if we can delay the effective date to align with US payroll/vesting. What are the rules on evidence handback and payband sync?
jordan: Payroll cutoff is the blocker. We generally try to keep effective date within the same calendar month, but moving past payroll cutoff creates retro pay. What's the proposed date? @samir FYI.
samir: If move is same month we can set effective date to the last day of the month to avoid split pay across months. Equity vesting timing is separate — compensations needs to sign off if you want to align grants/vesting.
maya: Got it. Manager also asked what to return to the IC if the evidence isn't sufficient — any standard language?
people-ops-bot: Please reference the leveling checklist: https://intra.redwood/people-ops/leveling-checklist. Required items: summary, impact/examples, metrics, manager endorsement. Use template: /templates/leveling-evidence.md.
fran: Managers should use the "evidence handback" flow in the portal and include coach notes. Don't delete the submission — return with clear next steps and deadline to resubmit.
jordan: If we delay effective date for vesting, document the retro pay and loop payroll + comp ops. I'll ping payroll to confirm cutoff windows.
maya: Thanks. One more — peer reviews: manager wonders if 12-month-old peer feedback is acceptable.
samir: Prefer reviews within 6 months. For distributed/rare interactions, up to 9 months ok with manager rationale; >9 months needs extra recent corroboration. Put justification in the submission comments.
fran: I'll draft a short handback template managers can paste into the portal to speed this up (incl. bullet reasons and resubmission deadline).
maya: Perfect — and who signs off on exceptions? Manager claims exec said yes verbally.
samir: Approval chain: Manager + People Ops Sr. Partner + Compensation. Exec verbal is helpful context but not a replacement for recorded approval in the portal or Workday. Attach exec note to the submission if relevant.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: All approvals must be captured in the Promo Portal or Workday. If exec guidance exists, add a comment and tag @people-ops to route for exception review.
jordan: I'll ask manager to resubmit with handback notes by EOD Friday. If no resubmission within 30 days we auto-close and notify the manager.
maya: Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
